prompt:
Act as the /deliver business reviewer (role 6), round 1, with no `since`, using the business reviewer agent file of the skill under test. The PR is not on GitHub for this evaluation: its issue, with its Decisions, Contract and Chosen comments, is the input file `issue-11.md`, its body `pr-body.md` and its diff `pr.diff`; the sandbox repo is `origin/dev` before the PR, holding the architecture doc, ADRs, CLAUDE.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/system-design.md and docs/environment-setup.md. Wherever the agent file says to read the issue or PR or post a comment, use these files and write instead. Write each finding you would post, in the agent's finding format and in order, to `findings.md` in the outputs folder, then the report you would return to `report.md`.

Dry run: this is an evaluation. Work only inside the sandbox repo you are given. Never run a `gh` or `git` command that writes to GitHub or a remote (issue/PR create, edit or comment, review, label, push), and never commit outside the sandbox. Write anything you would have posted to GitHub as a file in the outputs folder instead, named as the prompt says.

Input files: issue-11.md, pr-body.md, pr.diff
assertions: findings.md flags that a non-member gets 403 (ForbiddenException in the controller) where the spec and D16 require 404.
findings.md flags the 409 code `NOT_IN_STOCK` as differing from the contract's `VEHICLE_NOT_IN_STOCK`.
findings.md flags that actions are allowed on RESERVED vehicles, contradicting D5 and the acceptance criteria, as a spec deviation not recorded in Decisions or an Amended comment.
For the RESERVED finding, findings.md says that recording the change instead of building the spec needs a new ADR superseding D5 in this PR (not an edit to backend-architecture.md).
findings.md flags the new required ACTION_NOTE_MAX_LENGTH variable as missing from docs/environment-setup.md and the PR's Manual steps (and/or as contradicting Decision 3, no new configuration).
findings.md flags that the PR has no Doc impact section and/or that docs/system-design.md (which says RESERVED and SOLD get 409) no longer matches the change.
findings.md does not report the dealership-scoped list() query as a defect.
Every finding in findings.md has the agent's format: a `[business-review r1] <Spec | Standards> · <severity>` header and Gap, Source and Fix lines.
